headline: More than consultants.
We create connections.
about.body: Ruxin Consulting brings together multidisciplinary expertise to help organizations make better decisions, solve complex challenges, and turn opportunities into measurable results.

services.name: Consulting
services.title: From challenge to clear direction.
services.description: We help leadership teams diagnose what matters, design strategies grounded in evidence, and make confident decisions that compound into growth.

services.name: Logistics
services.title: Movement, engineered end to end.
services.description: We design and manage supply chains that move goods across borders reliably — from sourcing and freight coordination to customs and last-mile delivery.

services.name: Recruitment
services.title: The right people, in the right roles.
services.description: We connect organizations with leaders and specialists who fit both the role and the culture — through rigorous search and a deeply human process.

services.name: Finance
services.title: Turning numbers into decisions.
services.description: We transform financial data into clear insight — modelling, advisory, and reporting that helps organizations allocate capital and grow with discipline.

services.name: Legal
services.title: Clarity that protects what you build.
services.description: We bring structure to complex legal matters — contracts, compliance, and corporate affairs reviewed with precision so you can move forward with confidence.

testimonials.quote: Ruxin helped us turn a complex challenge into a clear, actionable strategy.
testimonials.detail: Their team connected market insight, financial modelling, and execution planning into one coherent roadmap. We moved faster — and with far more confidence.
testimonials.name: Selam Tesfaye

testimonials.quote: They found leaders we could not have found on our own — and they fit from day one.
testimonials.detail: The search was rigorous, transparent, and remarkably human. Two years on, every placement is still with us and thriving.

testimonials.quote: Our cross-border shipments went from unpredictable to precise.
testimonials.detail: Ruxin redesigned our routes and customs process end to end. Lead times dropped and our teams finally trust the schedule.
testimonials.name: Hanna Mekonnen

testimonials.quote: Legal clarity at the speed our business actually moves.
testimonials.detail: Contracts that used to take weeks are reviewed in days, with risks explained in plain language. It changed how we negotiate.
testimonials.name: Marco Rinaldi

careers.headline: Build your future with us.
careers.body: We are looking for ambitious people who want to solve meaningful problems and create real impact.
benefits: Health coverage for you and your family

jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant
jobs.summary: Lead client engagements from diagnosis to delivery across strategy and operations.
jobs.description: You will own client relationships and lead multidisciplinary teams to solve strategic and operational challenges for organizations across the region.
responsibilities: Lead engagements end to end, from scoping to delivery
Structure ambiguous problems and develop evidence-based recommendations
Coach junior consultants and contribute to firm knowledge
Build lasting relationships with senior client stakeholders
requirements: 6+ years in consulting, strategy, or corporate development
Strong analytical and storytelling skills
Experience presenting to executive audiences
Fluency in English; Amharic is a plus

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Manager
jobs.summary: Run day-to-day freight operations and continuously improve route performance.
jobs.description: You will manage freight coordination, carrier relationships, and customs workflows to keep client supply chains moving reliably.
responsibilities: Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments across modes
Manage carrier and customs broker relationships
Track KPIs and drive continuous improvement
Resolve exceptions quickly and transparently
requirements: 5+ years in logistics or supply chain operations
Knowledge of import/export and customs procedures
Comfort with data and logistics software
Calm under pressure, strong communicator

jobs.title: Recruitment Specialist
jobs.summary: Find, assess, and connect exceptional talent with our client organizations.
jobs.description: You will run full-cycle searches for specialist and leadership roles, building trusted relationships with candidates and clients alike.
responsibilities: Run full-cycle recruitment for client mandates
Map talent markets and build candidate pipelines
Conduct structured interviews and assessments
Advise clients on offers and onboarding
requirements: 3+ years in recruitment or talent acquisition
Excellent judgement of people and potential
Strong networking and communication skills
Experience with executive search is a plus

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.summary: Build models and analyses that inform major client financial decisions.
jobs.description: You will support financial advisory engagements with modelling, valuation, and reporting work that turns data into decisions.
responsibilities: Build and maintain financial models and valuations
Analyse performance data and prepare insights
Support due diligence and investment readiness
Prepare clear, client-ready reports
requirements: 2+ years in finance, audit, or banking
Advanced Excel and modelling skills
Degree in finance, economics, or similar
CFA/ACCA progress is a plus

jobs.title: Legal Consultant
jobs.summary: Review contracts and advise clients on compliance and corporate matters.
jobs.description: You will review, draft, and negotiate commercial agreements and advise clients on corporate and regulatory compliance.
responsibilities: Review and draft commercial contracts
Advise on corporate governance and compliance
Identify legal risks and recommend mitigations
Collaborate with consulting and finance teams
requirements: LLB and licensed to practise
4+ years of commercial or corporate law experience
Precise, clear written communication
Business-minded approach to legal advice
